fieldData.description: To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drink & food with your fellow Australian community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This first-ever event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food! Free Radix Swag for every attendee! NFT giveaways! Feel free to reach out to @XRDWhale on telegram for any clarification. Join Radix Australia on telegram to get involved and meet like minded Australians. Telegram: https://t.me/RadixAustralia
fieldData.location: The Oxford Scholar427 Swanston Street, Melbourne, VIC, 3000
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Melbourne
